name: lyria
label: Lyria 3 Pro
description: Lyria 3 Pro (StarskreamEXE/lyria-3-pro) embedded as a sidecar: Google Lyria 3 cloud song generation with vocals and lyrics, which the local SA3/Magenta stack cannot produce. Runs its own Express server on 5188 and is embedded whole. Mock mode is ON by default (real generations cost $0.08 each); set theDAW_LYRIA_MOCK=0 to spend.
